commands_and_results.detail: test_performance_telemetry.py:1131-1165 calls SubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder('2330.TW', side='sell', quantity=3, action='SELL') on a fresh algorithm with 0 holdings and asserts ledger['positions'][0]['quantity'] == -3.0, which is now rejected with sell_without_holdings per AC1. services/execution/lean_runtime/test_performance_telemetry.py is missing from the task artifact contract.

Existing tests in test_paper_runtime.py (TestSubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder.test_taiwan_paper_fill_published_with_shioaji_trade_id at L2722 asserting Quantity == -1 after zero-holding sell, TestSubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder.test_taiwan_broker_error_records_rejection at L2787 selling 2330.TW with 0 holdings expecting broker submission, and 7 tests in TestCommittedCloseLifecycleRecovery at L3915-4090 opening 2330.TW with a zero-holding SELL/SHORT before closing with BUY/LONG) directly conflict with AC1 (rejecting zero/negative holding Taiwan sell with sell_without_holdings) and AC4/next ('the existing paper runtime and executor tests pass unchanged; do not weaken an existing assertion').

blocker_summary: Per task instruction ('do not weaken an existing assertion ... if an item here is wrong or a needed file is missing from the artifact contract then block with the exact reason instead of working around it'): (1) services/execution/lean_runtime/test_performance_telemetry.py is missing from the task artifact contract, yet .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml (L334) runs pytest on services/execution/lean_runtime where PaperPerformanceLedgerTest.test_taiwan_sell_fill_is_signed_and_credits_cash (L1131-1165) sells 3 shares of 2330.TW from 0 holdings and asserts position quantity == -3.0; (2) AC4 states 'the existing paper runtime and executor tests pass unchanged' and next forbids weakening existing assertions, which conflicts with 9 existing zero-holding Taiwan SELL tests in services/execution/lean_runtime/test_paper_runtime.py (TestSubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder L2722 & L2787, and TestCommittedCloseLifecycleRecovery L3915-4090).
